title: Great tour, interesting place
text: Great tour. Gemma, our guide, was very knowledgeable and pointed out lots of interesting stuff that we would have missed had we not been on the tour. An amazing place to visit and lots to do and see after the tour finished so definitely worth the money. Highly recommended

title: Great Guided Tour experience in Barcelona
text:
I am so glad I booked a guided tour with Icono Spain Tours for our visit to the Sagrada Família in late October 2026! Since there weren't many reviews, I was initially a little hesitant, but after such a wonderful experience, I wanted to leave this review to help others planning their trip to Barcelona.

A special shout-out to our guide, CHRISTEL, who was not only incredibly knowledgeable about the city and its history but also genuinely kind and caring. We were so blessed by her warm heart and the way she looked after everyone in our group, making sure each person had a wonderful experience.
author: U5197IWhelenl

title: Beautiful Sagrada + an amazing tour guide
text: The tour was fun and very informative. Sagrada Familia was truly incredible! Our tour guide, Gemma, was very kind and knowledgeable. We learned a lot of the stories behind the creation of Sagrada and some of Gaudi’s thought process. We definitely recommend joining a tour when coming to Sagrada - helps you skip the line, plus learn about the church itself! Thank you for an amazing tour, Gemma!

title: Superb visit from start to finish
text: Everything went very smoothly and according to plan. Our guide, Crystel was so well organised and delightful. She instantly engaged with the group and gave us a most informative tour. Her own passion for the building was obvious and infectious - she was so generous with her time and answered our questions in great detail such was her extraordinary knowledge. The building is totally FABULOUS and has to be seen to be believed. Book well ahead of your trip for the best prices and trust in the system because it does work. 90 minutes with the guide is sufficient - you can then stay inside the Sagra
author: 610alidaw

title: Memorable experience of Sagrada Familia
text: The best way to experience Sagrada Familia. We booked our tour with Ikono tours and had Elyria as our guide. She was on time and took us through the cathedral with absolute charm and fun. She was funny and knowledgeable and entertaining throughout. Showed us each part and lots of hidden details. Memorable experience.
author: rajatc143

title: Awe-inspiring Sagrada Familia
text: The Sagrada Familia tour was just the right length.  We picked the 5:30pm schedule which was close to sunset & gave us amazing views of Gaudi’s stained glass windows.  Our guide, Christele, was very friendly & accommodating.  She spoke good English & was very informative.  She made our group feel very comfortable with her.
